entries.en:
Word of your deeds has spread, and now citizens have turned to the emissaries of ardor and affection en masse for assistance with their assorted woes. Left alone to field this sudden influx of patrons, Pukty Piko seeks your aid in tidying up these poor people's problems. Speak with her to begin the arduous─though no doubt rewarding─task of giving these citizens a reason to smile this Valentione's Day.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en: Pardon my tardiness. Miounne was kind enough to set out tea for me, and I could hardly refuse such an offer. It warmed my heart, to see such munificence! And, now that I reflect on it, such hospitality too is one form of love, isn't it. But I digress, what does Miounne write?
entries.fr: Miounne m'a offert une tasse de thé. Ça m'a donné chaud au cœur, kupo... C'est une marque d'affection, ça aussi ? Tenez, voici sa réponse, kupo...
entries.ja:
ミューヌに、お茶をごちそうになったクポ。
胸がポカポカ……これも、ラブのひとつクポ？

entries.en: What a relief it is to read this! She has seen how steadfast our convictions to the guild are. By hook or by crook, we shall not disappoint her! I, for one, am afire with determination!
entries.fr: Ouf ! Elle dit qu'elle apprécie notre attitude et qu'elle nous confiera bientôt une autre mission ! Nous redoublerons d'efforts pour ne pas la décevoir, cette fois !
entries.ja:
よかった……ちゃんと気持ちが伝わったみたいです。
手紙に書いた言葉を裏切らないように、
今後もがんばろうと思います。

entries.en: Your advice has rung true indeed. Thank you for your wisdom. We shan't forget it!
entries.fr: Merci beaucoup pour votre aide ! Et que la chance vous accompagne dans vos propres aventures !

本当にお世話になりました。
あなたも、どうかよい旅を……。

entries.en: Though she commends us on our ambition and zeal, she worries that we put our lives at risk by attempting tasks which exceed our abilities. I cannot deny the truth of what she says. Well, I'm decided─“circumspection” shall be our watchword going forward!
entries.fr: Elle dit qu'elle apprécie notre enthousiasme, mais qu'un excès de confiance peut s'avérer fatal dans notre métier... Elle a raison. Nous devrons faire beaucoup plus attention, désormais.
entries.ja:
意気込みはいいが、背伸びしすぎると命にかかわる、と……
ミューヌさんの仰る通りですね、もっと気を引き締めないと。

entries.en: You were wise to advise us as you did. I thank you for your help.
entries.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, merci pour vos conseils. Au revoir.
entries.ja: 助言してくださって、ありがとうございました。
entries.speaker: ADVENTURER04467

entries.en: Fancy seeing you here! And fancier still that you are the one to assist me. My conundrum is that, as ever, my brother and I are concerned for Kan-E's well-being. We thought to write her, but I know not what to say, and A-Ruhn has lifted not a digit to help.

C'est vous qui allez me conseiller ? Bon...
Je veux écrire une lettre à ma sœur, Kan-E. J'en ai discuté avec mon frère, et il m'a demandé de la rédiger.

entries.en: I would ask her to be mindful of her health, but does that not sound rather...fussy? Even more so when couched in “dearest sisters” and formal prose! Though I suppose Kan-E is both formal and fussy herself...

entries.en: What is more, I haven't much practice in the ways of penning properly worded missives. My sister is, as I mentioned, a touch on the fussy side, and holds manners and decorum in high regard. Little doubt that she will read my words with a rather critical eye.
entries.fr: Malheureusement, je dois bien avouer que je n'ai pas du tout l'habitude de cet exercice, et ma sœur est tellement sérieuse et protocolaire que j'hésite un peu sur la forme, alors j'aurais besoin de vos lumières.

だから、ちょっとアドバイスしてくれない？

entries.en: The Elder Seedseer is a wonderful woman, as many have said. She saw how nervous I was and put me at my ease immediately! Your sister is lovely indeed.
entries.fr: J'étais un peu stressée de rencontrer dame Kan-E-Senna en personne, mais elle était aussi gentille qu'on le raconte, kupo...
entries.ja:
カヌ・エ様、緊張したけど、
噂通りで、とっても優しいヒトだったクポ……。

entries.en: I am glad to hear it. Let us see how she replies. Hm... She applauds me for the maturity I show in writing her, and says that as an older sister, she could not be more proud. What a curious response! I ask her to watch her health, and she commends me on my maturity?
entries.fr: Elle me dit qu'elle est fière de voir à quel point sa petite sœur a bien grandi... Je lui conseille de souffler un peu, et elle me félicite ?
entries.ja:
姉として、妹の成長が感じられて嬉しい……ですって。
休んでほしいと伝えたはずなのに、褒められるってどういうこと？

entries.en: Strange as this answer is, it seems our words of worry have gotten through to her, thankfully. Though I was initially reluctant, I am glad we wrote her. My heart is lighter knowing she is well. Your assistance in these family matters is much appreciated.
entries.fr: En tout cas, je crois que le message est passé. Ce genre d'échange est un peu gênant, mais ça peut être bien de temps en temps... Je vous remercie  les deux pour votre aide. Au revoir.

ま、言いたいことは伝わったみたいだし、
照れくさいけど、たまにはこういうのも悪くないわね。
あんたたち、世話になったわ。

entries.fr: Enfin bon, peu importe. Je ne vais pas vous déranger plus longtemps.
entries.ja: まあいいわ、邪魔したわね。

entries.en: But as for why I'm here today, well...I want to write a letter to Kupka Kupp, to thank him for his support. Whenever I feel low, like I want to give up on my dream of seeing the world, Kupka is there for me to lift my spirits.
entries.fr: J'ai un service à vous demander... J'aimerais envoyer une lettre à ce cher Kupka Kupp qui a toujours été là pour me réconforter quand j'étais sur le point d'abandonner. Je veux lui montrer que je pense à lui.

私がお勉強に挫けそうになったとき、
いつも励ましてくれるお礼をしたくて……。

entries.en: Support him in his endeavors as he supports you in yours.
entries.fr: En souhaitant leur réussite mutuelle
entries.ja: お互いがんばろうと励ましあう

entries.en: I've taken your words to heart. I only hope this letter is enough to show Kupka how much he means to me.

entries.en: If only you could have seen the look on Kupka's face when I told him who had written him. He couldn't stop twirling through the air! It was adorable, but don't tell him I said that. He was so touched, he managed to find time between his many deliveries to craft a reply, which I have here.
entries.fr: Quand j'ai dit à Kupka Kupp que j'avais une lettre de la part d'Elyne, il a bondi de joie, kupo ! Il s'est dépêché d'écrire sa réponse entre deux livraisons.

entries.fr: Il dit qu'il a été touché par mon message plein d'affection et me remercie. Je suis toujours contente de lui parler, mais j'avoue que s'échanger des lettres a un charme tout particulier.

ラブの詰まったお手紙ありがとう、だって！

こうやってお手紙を書くのも素敵だね。

entries.fr: Je ne sais pas où est passée votre lettre, mais j'en ai trouvé une autre qui dégage le même parfum fleuri que la première, kupo...

entries.en: I just knew my sweet little sapling could suss out who I was from the clues I planted in my letter! Your affection for me was writ so plainly in your last correspondence, I shall return it here, in kind. How could I do less!
entries.fr: (-Lettre du Monarque féerique-)Tu vois que tu peux quand tu veux, mon petit arbrisseau ! Et puisque tu m'as montré autant d'affection, je vais faire de même en retour !

もらった分だけ返すのが、私たちの流儀だもの。

entries.en: My precious sapling, wherever your travels may take you, wherever the roads you walk lead, know that my heart goes with you. Every step of every path, be they through dungeons dank and dark or to mountain peaks magnificent, I am there, watching over you, always and forever.

ええ、ええ、それは間違いなくそう。

entries.en: And only that much. For as far as the contents of your letter are concerned, I am less than pleased. No, I am putting it too lightly. I am so far from pleased that I find myself incensed. Wrathful. Furious! You, sapling, should show your lovely branch the affection I so rightly deserve...
